# dokploy_ssh_key (Data Source)

Fetches a single SSH key from Dokploy by ID or name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The SSH key name to look up. Mutually exclusive with ssh_key_id.
- `ssh_key_id` (String) The SSH key ID to look up. Mutually exclusive with name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp of the SSH key.
- `description` (String) The description of the SSH key.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the SSH key (same as ssh_key_id).
- `last_used_at` (String) The last used timestamp of the SSH key.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization ID the SSH key belongs to.
- `public_key` (String) The public key.
